source_note: Primary: live in-situ water temperature (CO-OPS gauge, else a nearby NDBC buoy) as the latest daily anomaly vs a 1991-2020 climatology. That climatology is the official NOAA OISST v2.1 1991-2020 normal at the nearest OISST water pixel, bias-matched to the sensor over the overlapping record. A sensor is stale if the last observation is older than 36 hours, or if fewer than 60 of the last 90 days have a daily mean. The warm-water term is W = k × that latest daily anomaly (ssta). The field ssta30_c is a legacy key and equals ssta; it is not a multi-day mean. Fallback: official NOAA Coral Reef Watch CoralTemp SST anomaly vs 1991-2020 (outer coast and, this build, also Puget Sound / bays when in-situ is missing). OISST 25 km is last resort only.

9439040.k_src: fit 2023-06..2025-10 monthly residual vs new 1991-2020 SSTA
9439040.coverage_flag: only 46 of last 90 days have a daily mean; recent coverage is still sufficient, so the latest daily anomaly is used
